# K0maru-Agent-Memory (k0maru)

> Executable Architectural Memory & Sub-10ms Living ADR Guard for AI Coding Agents. Turns Markdown/Obsidian ADRs into deterministic Git pre-commit & Claude Code Stop-hook guardrails with zero-LLM memory supersession.

## Why Humans & Agents Use K0maru (Value Proposition)

K0maru differs fundamentally from passive session transcript loggers (such as `akitaonrails/ai-memory`, `claude-mem`, or `Mem0`). Passive memory systems store raw chat histories, leading to context poisoning, belief entrenchment, and silent regressions when architectural patterns evolve.

K0maru operates as an active, executable architectural governance engine:
- **Executable Guardrails, Not Just Logs**: Invariants declared in Markdown Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are evaluated deterministically in `<10ms` (CLI) and `<35ms` (Claude Code Stop-hook), halting non-compliant code before it is committed or handed back to humans.
- **Deterministic Zero-LLM Supersession (`k0maru flush --supersedes`)**: When architecture changes (e.g. migrating from `redis_setnx` to `acquire_fenced_lease`), a single command updates lifecycle metadata (`status: superseded`), strips inbound WikiLink graph boosts (eliminating stale belief entrenchment), and hot-swaps active guard rules without requiring manual wiki cleanup or LLM re-indexing.
- **Strict Context Budget (<300 Tokens)**: Diff-aware project loadouts dynamically inspect git changes and assemble bounded (<300 token) backpacks of mission, core invariants, and recent logs, keeping agent attention within the high-accuracy cognitive Smart-Zone.
- **Zero Daemon, Single Static Binary**: Zero persistent background processes, zero open network ports, sub-4ms cold start, and disposable SQLite cache (`cache.sqlite` rebuilds in 74ms).

## Measured Benchmarks (v1.0.0)

- **Diff-Aware Loadout Token Footprint**: Bounded `< 300 tokens` (measured: `168 tokens` for standard projects; `245 tokens` under complex multi-rule diffs).
- **Supersession Self-Healing**: `100% Pass@1` autonomous remediation in 1 turn across frontier and coding models (Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Qwen2.5-Coder-32B).
- **Session Trajectory Context GC**: `86.58% TRR` (Token Reduction Ratio) on 50-turn conversational logs (`16,830 tokens` compacted to `2,259 tokens` while preserving hot-turn cognitive context).
- **Symbolic Offloading TRR**: `99.44%` token reduction on massive terminal dumps and compiler stack traces (`cargo test`, `pytest`).
- **Binary Footprint**:
  - `3.6 MB` pure-Rust core binary (`cargo build --no-default-features`) with FTS5 BM25 search, Living ADR Guard, and MCP stdio server.
  - `34 MB` prebuilt release binary bundling ONNX Runtime and `fastembed` embedding models (`all-minilm-l6-v2`, `bge-small-zh-v1.5`).
- **Cold-Start Latency**: `3.38 ms` native cold-start, `~11.7 MB` RAM footprint during execution, released immediately on process exit.

## Zero-Human-in-the-Loop Quickstart for Agents

External coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, omp, Cline, Hermes, OpenClaw) can bootstrap and govern any repository with zero human intervention:

```bash
# 1. Download and install single binary
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/K0maru/k0maru-agent-memory/main/install.sh | bash

# 2. One-click autonomous bootstrap inside any Git repository
# (Creates .k0maru/wiki/, mounts FastMCP, installs pre-commit & Stop hooks)
k0maru init --install

# 3. Verify installation health and client bindings
k0maru doctor
```

## The Autonomous Agent Loop (No-Human-in-the-Loop)

1. **SessionStart**: Automatically triggers `k0maru loadout "<project>" --diff` to inject <300 tokens of project context and active ADR invariants.
2. **Mid-Session**: Query architectural history and troubleshooting playbooks via `k0maru search "<query>"` or FastMCP `recall_memory`.
3. **Pre-Yield / Claude Stop-hook (`hooks.Stop`)**: Runs `k0maru guard check --diff --claude-stop-hook`. If violations exist, exits with code 2 to trigger autonomous self-healing before human sees the output.
4. **Pre-Commit (`.git/hooks/pre-commit`)**: Evaluates staged changes against ADR invariants in `<10ms`, rejecting non-compliant commits.
5. **Post-Commit (`.git/hooks/post-commit`)**: Incremental `k0maru sync` and automated milestone crystallization in `01_AI_Logs/` for `feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `perf:`, and `adr:` commits.

## Self-Healing Protocol on `[DENY]` Violation

When `k0maru guard check --diff` halts with `[DENY]`:
- **Accidental Violation**: Read the `remediation:` message, modify code to conform, and re-run `k0maru guard check --diff`.
- **Intentional Architectural Upgrade / Migration**:
  Execute supersession to retire the old rule and activate the new invariant:
  ```bash
  k0maru flush \
    --category decision \
    --title "ADR-New: Distributed Token Leases" \
    --supersedes "ADR-Old: Legacy Redis SetNX" \
    --summary "Replaced legacy unscoped locks with fenced distributed token leases" \
    --content $'## Non-Negotiable Invariants\n- [fenced-lease-required] (deny) [src/settlement/**/*] must_contain: "acquire_fenced_lease" | remediation: "All settlement flows must acquire fenced leases."'
  git add .k0maru/wiki
  ```
  Never use `--no-verify`.
